ox2r_gq_gs.interpretation: Identical pocket profiles (Jaccard similarity=1.0); HIGH gateway divergence

integrity_note: jaccard_dist column = 1 - Jaccard_similarity. jaccard_dist=0.0 means IDENTICAL pocket profiles. jaccard_dist=1.0 means COMPLETELY DIFFERENT pocket profiles. The manuscript previously incorrectly called OX2R Gq-Gs (dist=0.0) 'complete non-overlap'. OX2R Gq-Gs actually has IDENTICAL pocket profiles (both in orthosteric cluster 1 only).
